name: Chest Supported Row (Barbell)
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a barbell on the floor below you and grab it with an overhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight with the bar just off the floor.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause with the bar at the bench.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A barbell row done lying chest-down on a bench, which takes the lower back out of the exercise and isolates the upper back.
